mapper.select: /* CastSlfchknMapper.retrieveSmltSlfchknList */ SELECT TIME, TYPE, ISLAND, SUM(WTNG_PSG_CNT) as WTNG_PSG_CNT, AVG(PRCS_HR) as PRCS_HR, AVG(WTNG_HR) as WTNG_HR FROM ( SELECT A.YMD, A.TIME, B.TMNL_ID, CASE WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = 'CK' THEN 'KIOSK' ELSE B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD END as TYPE, CASE WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = 'CK' THEN SUBSTR(B.SMLT_FCLT_NM, -3, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = 'SBD' THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, -3, 1) END as ISLAND, A.WTNG_PSG_CNT, A.PRCS_HR, A.WTNG_HR FROM ( SELECT A.SMLT_ID, REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 0, 10), '/', '') YMD, REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 12, 5), ':', '') TIME, PSG_FCLT_CD, A.WTNG_PSG_CNT, A.AVG_PRCS_HR as PRCS_HR, A.AVG_WTNG_HR as WTNG_HR FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A WHERE A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 ) A INNER JOIN ( SELECT PSG_FCLT_CD, UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, PSG_FCLT_NM, TMNL_ID, SMLT_FCLT_NM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('CK', 'SBD') AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 ) GROUP BY TIME, TYPE, ISLAND ORDER BY TIME, TYPE, ISLAND

/* CastSlfchknMapper.retrieveSlfDeviceCntList */ SELECT ISLAND, SLF_TYPE, COUNT(PSG_FCLT_CD) AS DEVICE_CNT FROM ( SELECT B.PSG_FCLT_CD, CASE WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = 'CK' THEN 'KIOSK' ELSE B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD END AS SLF_TYPE, CASE WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = 'CK' THEN SUBSTR(B.SMLT_FCLT_NM, -3, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = 'SBD' THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, -3, 1) END AS ISLAND FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('CK', 'SBD') AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE ISLAND IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ISLAND, SLF_TYPE ORDER BY ISLAND, SLF_TYPE
